note: Regulatory milestones for the EU Digital Product Passport. Dates drive the live countdowns on /digital-product-passport, so every entry needs a real ISO date and a source anyone can check. Maintained by the 'DPP regulatory watch' Routine; see docs/strategy/persuasion-doctrine.md for the copy rules.

milestones.label: EU DPP registry rules adopted
milestones.detail: The Commission adopted Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/1778 on the DPP registry on 16 July 2026.
milestones.badge: EU DPP registry rules adopted: Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/1778

milestones.label: Industrial & EV Batteries (≥2 kWh)
milestones.detail: Mandatory DPP for EV, industrial storage and LMT batteries. Carbon footprint, material declaration and recycled content required.

milestones.label: Electronics & ICT Products
milestones.detail: Smartphones, tablets and laptops. Repairability scores, spare parts availability and recycled material content.

milestones.label: Textiles, Apparel & Footwear
milestones.detail: Fibre composition, recycled content, country of origin and care instructions via DPP.

milestones.label: Construction Products & Furniture
milestones.detail: Structural products, insulation and furniture enter scope under the ESPR working plan.
